exposure: native renal biopsy during pregnancy and postpartum
indications for biopsy (nephrotic syndrome, acute kidney injury)
outcome: pathological findings on biopsy (e.g., Lupus nephritis)
cohort: The study included 32 women who underwent native renal biopsies during pregnancy and postpartum between 2015 and 2022.
finding: Lupus nephritis was the most common finding on biopsy, with no procedure-related serious adverse effects, although most pregnancies were complicated by hypertensive disorders and preterm birth.
